replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA is a way to simplify data by reducing the number of variables. First, standardize your data. Then, compute the covariance matrix. Next, calculate the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of this matrix. Sort the eigenvalues in descending order and choose the top k eigenvalues. Project the data onto the new subspace formed by the corresponding eigenvectors.
